question: Which of the following is a function of Nepal Rastra Bank as the central bank?
question_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकका रूपमा नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको कार्य तलकामध्ये कुन हो?
options: Banker to the government and lender of last resort
explanation: As central bank, NRB acts as banker to the government, lender of last resort to banks, issuer of currency and manager of foreign exchange reserves.
explanation_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकका रूपमा राष्ट्र बैंक सरकारको बैंकर, बैंकहरूको अन्तिम ऋणदाता, मुद्रा जारीकर्ता र विदेशी विनिमय सञ्चिति व्यवस्थापकका रूपमा कार्य गर्छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: In NRB's monetary policy for FY 2082/83, what is the policy rate (the middle of the interest rate corridor)?
question_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकको आ.व. २०८२/८३ को मौद्रिक नीतिमा नीतिगत दर (ब्याजदर करिडोरको मध्य) कति छ?
explanation: In the FY 2082/83 monetary policy (July 2025), the policy rate was cut from 5% to 4.5%; the bank rate is 6% and the deposit collection rate 2.75%.
explanation_ne: आ.व. २०८२/८३ को मौद्रिक नीति (जुलाई २०२५) मा नीतिगत दर ५% बाट ४.५% मा झारियो; बैंक दर ६% र निक्षेप सङ्कलन दर २.७५% छ।

question: In NRB's interest rate corridor, which rate is the upper bound (ceiling)?
question_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकको ब्याजदर करिडोरमा माथिल्लो सीमा (ceiling) कुन दर हो?
explanation: The bank rate is the ceiling of the interest rate corridor (6% in FY 2082/83); the policy rate is the middle (4.5%) and the deposit collection rate the floor (2.75%).
explanation_ne: बैंक दर ब्याजदर करिडोरको माथिल्लो सीमा हो (आ.व. २०८२/८३ मा ६%); नीतिगत दर मध्य (४.५%) र निक्षेप सङ्कलन दर तल्लो सीमा (२.७५%) हो।

question: In NRB's interest rate corridor, which rate is the lower bound (floor)?
question_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकको ब्याजदर करिडोरमा तल्लो सीमा (floor) कुन दर हो?
explanation: The deposit collection rate is the floor of the interest rate corridor (2.75% in FY 2082/83); the bank rate is the ceiling (6%) and the policy rate the middle (4.5%).
explanation_ne: निक्षेप सङ्कलन दर ब्याजदर करिडोरको तल्लो सीमा हो (आ.व. २०८२/८३ मा २.७५%); बैंक दर माथिल्लो सीमा (६%) र नीतिगत दर मध्य (४.५%) हो।

question: In which month does Nepal Rastra Bank normally announce its annual monetary policy?
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले सामान्यतया आफ्नो वार्षिक मौद्रिक नीति कुन महिनामा घोषणा गर्छ?
explanation: NRB announces its annual monetary policy in July, at the start of the fiscal year (Shrawan) — e.g. the FY 2082/83 policy was unveiled in July 2025.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकले आर्थिक वर्षको सुरुमा जुलाई (साउन) मा वार्षिक मौद्रिक नीति घोषणा गर्छ — जस्तै आ.व. २०८२/८३ को नीति जुलाई २०२५ मा सार्वजनिक भयो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) that banks in Nepal must maintain with Nepal Rastra Bank?
question_ne: नेपालका बैंकहरूले नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकमा राख्नुपर्ने नगद मौज्दात अनुपात (CRR) कति छ?
explanation: Banks in Nepal must maintain a Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) of 3% of their deposits with Nepal Rastra Bank.
explanation_ne: नेपालका बैंकहरूले आफ्नो निक्षेपको ३% नगद मौज्दात अनुपात (CRR) का रूपमा नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकमा राख्नुपर्छ।

question: What inflation rate did NRB's monetary policy for FY 2082/83 aim to contain inflation within?
question_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकको आ.व. २०८२/८३ को मौद्रिक नीतिले मुद्रास्फीति कति प्रतिशतभित्र सीमित राख्ने लक्ष्य राखेको थियो?
explanation: NRB's monetary policy for FY 2082/83 aimed to contain inflation within 5%.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकको आ.व. २०८२/८३ को मौद्रिक नीतिले मुद्रास्फीति ५% भित्र सीमित राख्ने लक्ष्य राखेको थियो।

question: Which was Nepal's first joint venture bank, established in 1984?
question_ne: सन् १९८४ मा स्थापित नेपालको पहिलो संयुक्त लगानी बैंक कुन हो?
options: Nepal Arab Bank Ltd (now Nabil Bank)
options_ne: नेपाल अरब बैंक लि. (हाल नबिल बैंक)
explanation: Nepal Arab Bank Ltd, established in 1984 and now Nabil Bank, was Nepal's first joint venture bank.
explanation_ne: सन् १९८४ मा स्थापित नेपाल अरब बैंक लि. (हाल नबिल बैंक) नेपालको पहिलो संयुक्त लगानी बैंक थियो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Which institution, established in 1959, was Nepal's first development finance institution?
question_ne: सन् १९५९ मा स्थापित नेपालको पहिलो विकास वित्त संस्था कुन हो?
explanation: The Nepal Industrial Development Corporation (NIDC), established in 1959, was Nepal's first development finance institution.
explanation_ne: सन् १९५९ मा स्थापित नेपाल औद्योगिक विकास निगम (NIDC) नेपालको पहिलो विकास वित्त संस्था थियो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: In Nepal's BFI classification, which class are development banks?
question_ne: नेपालको बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्था वर्गीकरणमा विकास बैंकहरू कुन वर्गमा पर्छन्?
explanation: Nepal classifies BFIs as: Class 'A' commercial banks, Class 'B' development banks, Class 'C' finance companies and Class 'D' microfinance institutions.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरूको वर्गीकरण छ: वर्ग 'क' वाणिज्य बैंक, वर्ग 'ख' विकास बैंक, वर्ग 'ग' वित्त कम्पनी र वर्ग 'घ' लघुवित्त संस्था।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: In Nepal's BFI classification, which class are microfinance institutions?
question_ne: नेपालको बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्था वर्गीकरणमा लघुवित्त संस्थाहरू कुन वर्गमा पर्छन्?
explanation: Microfinance institutions are Class 'D' financial institutions in Nepal's BFI classification.
explanation_ne: लघुवित्त संस्थाहरू नेपालको बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्था वर्गीकरणमा वर्ग 'घ' का वित्तीय संस्था हुन्।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: How many bank and financial institutions in total were licensed by NRB as of mid-July 2025?
question_ne: जुलाई २०२५ को मध्यसम्म राष्ट्र बैंकबाट इजाजत प्राप्त बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरू जम्मा कति थिए?
explanation: As of mid-July 2025, NRB had licensed 107 BFIs: 20 commercial banks, 17 development banks, 17 finance companies, 52 microfinance institutions and 1 infrastructure development bank.
explanation_ne: जुलाई २०२५ को मध्यसम्म राष्ट्र बैंकले १०७ बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थालाई इजाजत दिएको थियो: २० वाणिज्य बैंक, १७ विकास बैंक, १७ वित्त कम्पनी, ५२ लघुवित्त संस्था र १ पूर्वाधार विकास बैंक।
source: NRB Banking and Financial Statistics, mid-July 2025

question: What is the minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) that commercial banks in Nepal must maintain?
question_ne: नेपालका वाणिज्य बैंकहरूले कायम राख्नुपर्ने न्यूनतम पुँजी पर्याप्तता अनुपात (CAR) कति छ?
explanation: NRB requires commercial banks in Nepal to maintain a minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio of 11%; the sector average was about 12.61% in 2025.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकले नेपालका वाणिज्य बैंकहरूका लागि न्यूनतम पुँजी पर्याप्तता अनुपात ११% तोकेको छ; सन् २०२५ मा क्षेत्रको औसत करिब १२.६१% थियो।

question: Under Basel III, what is the minimum total capital ratio (including the capital conservation buffer)?
question_ne: बासेल III अन्तर्गत न्यूनतम कुल पुँजी अनुपात (पुँजी संरक्षण बफरसहित) कति हो?
explanation: Basel III requires minimum total capital of 8% plus a 2.5% capital conservation buffer, i.e. 10.5% in total (with CET1 of 4.5% and Tier 1 of 6%).
explanation_ne: बासेल III ले न्यूनतम कुल पुँजी ८% र त्यसमा २.५% पुँजी संरक्षण बफर गरी जम्मा १०.५% माग गर्छ (CET1 ४.५% र Tier 1 ६% सहित)।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Under Basel III, what is the minimum Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio?
question_ne: बासेल III अन्तर्गत न्यूनतम साझा इक्विटी टियर १ (CET1) पुँजी अनुपात कति हो?
explanation: Basel III requires minimum CET1 capital of 4.5% of risk-weighted assets (Tier 1 is 6% and total capital 8% before buffers).
explanation_ne: बासेल III ले जोखिम-भारित सम्पत्तिको न्यूनतम CET1 पुँजी ४.५% माग गर्छ (Tier 1 ६% र कुल पुँजी ८% बफरअघि)।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What percentage of their total loans must commercial banks in Nepal lend to the deprived sector?
question_ne: नेपालका वाणिज्य बैंकहरूले आफ्नो कुल कर्जाको कति प्रतिशत विपन्न क्षेत्रमा लगानी गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation: NRB requires commercial banks to extend at least 5% of their total loans to the deprived sector.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकले वाणिज्य बैंकहरूलाई आफ्नो कुल कर्जाको कम्तीमा ५% विपन्न क्षेत्रमा लगानी गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था गरेको छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the maximum Credit-to-Deposit (CD) ratio allowed by NRB for banks and financial institutions?
question_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकले बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरूका लागि तोकेको अधिकतम कर्जा-निक्षेप (CD) अनुपात कति हो?
explanation: NRB has set the CD ratio threshold at 90% — BFIs can lend at most 90% of their deposits; in 2025 most banks were operating well below this limit.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकले CD अनुपातको सीमा ९०% तोकेको छ — बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरूले आफ्नो निक्षेपको बढीमा ९०% सम्म कर्जा दिन सक्छन्; सन् २०२५ मा धेरै बैंकहरू यस सीमाभन्दा निकै तल सञ्चालनमा थिए।

question: What does CAMELS stand for in bank supervision?
question_ne: बैंक सुपरिवेक्षणमा CAMELS को अर्थ के हो?
options: Capital adequacy, Asset quality, Management, Earnings, Liquidity, Sensitivity
Cash, Assets, Money, Equity, Loans, Savings
Credit, Audit, Management, Equity, Liquidity, Security
Capital, Account, Market, Earning, Loan, Share
options_ne: पुँजी पर्याप्तता, सम्पत्ति गुणस्तर, व्यवस्थापन, आम्दानी, तरलता, संवेदनशीलता
नगद, सम्पत्ति, पैसा, इक्विटी, कर्जा, बचत
कर्जा, लेखापरीक्षण, व्यवस्थापन, इक्विटी, तरलता, सुरक्षा
पुँजी, खाता, बजार, आम्दानी, कर्जा, सेयर
explanation: CAMELS is the supervisory rating system: Capital adequacy, Asset quality, Management, Earnings, Liquidity and Sensitivity to market risk.
explanation_ne: CAMELS सुपरिवेक्षण मूल्याङ्कन प्रणाली हो: पुँजी पर्याप्तता, सम्पत्ति गुणस्तर, व्यवस्थापन, आम्दानी, तरलता र बजार जोखिमप्रति संवेदनशीलता।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What are the '5 Cs of credit' used by banks to assess borrowers?
question_ne: बैंकहरूले ऋणीको मूल्याङ्कन गर्न प्रयोग गर्ने 'कर्जाका ५ C' के-के हुन्?
explanation: The 5 Cs of credit are Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral and Conditions.
explanation_ne: कर्जाका ५ C हरू चरित्र (Character), क्षमता (Capacity), पुँजी (Capital), धितो (Collateral) र अवस्था (Conditions) हुन्।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Which bank introduced the first ATM in Nepal, and in which year?
question_ne: नेपालमा पहिलो ATM कुन बैंकले र कुन वर्षमा सुरु गर्‍यो?
explanation: Himalayan Bank Limited introduced the first ATM in Nepal in 1995, according to NRB's Bank Supervision Reports.
explanation_ne: राष्ट्र बैंकको बैंक सुपरिवेक्षण प्रतिवेदनअनुसार हिमालयन बैंक लिमिटेडले सन् १९९५ मा नेपालमा पहिलो ATM सुरु गरेको थियो।

question: Which bank first introduced the debit card in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा पहिलो पटक डेबिट कार्ड कुन बैंकले सुरु गर्‍यो?
options: Nepal Investment Bank (now Nepal Investment Mega Bank)
options_ne: नेपाल इन्भेष्टमेण्ट बैंक (हाल नेपाल इन्भेष्टमेण्ट मेगा बैंक)
explanation: Nepal Investment Bank Limited (now Nepal Investment Mega Bank) was the first bank to introduce the debit card in Nepal.
explanation_ne: नेपाल इन्भेष्टमेण्ट बैंक लिमिटेड (हाल नेपाल इन्भेष्टमेण्ट मेगा बैंक) नेपालमा डेबिट कार्ड सुरु गर्ने पहिलो बैंक थियो।

question: Which bank first introduced the credit card in Nepal in the early 1990s?
question_ne: सन् १९९० को दशकको सुरुमा नेपालमा पहिलो पटक क्रेडिट कार्ड कुन बैंकले सुरु गर्‍यो?
explanation: Credit card service was first introduced in Nepal by Nabil Bank Ltd (then Nepal Arab Bank Ltd) in the early 1990s.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा क्रेडिट कार्ड सेवा पहिलो पटक सन् १९९० को दशकको सुरुमा नबिल बैंक लि. (तत्कालीन नेपाल अरब बैंक लि.) ले सुरु गरेको थियो।

question: Which bank first introduced internet banking in Nepal, in 2002?
question_ne: सन् २००२ मा नेपालमा पहिलो पटक इन्टरनेट बैंकिङ कुन बैंकले सुरु गर्‍यो?
explanation: Internet banking was first introduced in Nepal by Kumari Bank Limited in 2002.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा इन्टरनेट बैंकिङ पहिलो पटक सन् २००२ मा कुमारी बैंक लिमिटेडले सुरु गरेको थियो।

question: Which is Nepal's first digital wallet, launched in 2009?
question_ne: सन् २००९ मा सुरु भएको नेपालको पहिलो डिजिटल वालेट कुन हो?
explanation: eSewa, launched in 2009 by F1Soft International, is Nepal's first digital wallet.
explanation_ne: सन् २००९ मा F1Soft International ले सुरु गरेको इसेवा नेपालको पहिलो डिजिटल वालेट हो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: In which year was connectIPS, Nepal's instant bank-account payment system, launched?
question_ne: नेपालको तत्काल बैंक खाता भुक्तानी प्रणाली connectIPS कुन वर्ष सुरु भएको थियो?
explanation: connectIPS, the bank-account-based instant payment system operated by Nepal Clearing House (NCHL), was launched in 2018.
explanation_ne: नेपाल क्लियरिङ हाउस (NCHL) द्वारा सञ्चालित बैंक खातामा आधारित तत्काल भुक्तानी प्रणाली connectIPS सन् २०१८ मा सुरु भएको थियो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is NepalQR, introduced by Nepal Rastra Bank?
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकले सुरु गरेको NepalQR के हो?
options: A standardised QR code for interoperable digital payments
A QR code only for tourists
options_ne: अन्तर-आबद्ध डिजिटल भुक्तानीका लागि मानकीकृत QR कोड
explanation: NepalQR, introduced by NRB in 2021, is a standardised QR code that makes QR payments interoperable across banks, wallets and payment service operators.
explanation_ne: सन् २०२१ मा राष्ट्र बैंकले सुरु गरेको NepalQR एउटा मानकीकृत QR कोड हो, जसले बैंक, वालेट र भुक्तानी सेवा प्रदायकहरूबीच QR भुक्तानी अन्तर-आबद्ध बनाउँछ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Which Act regulates foreign exchange transactions in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा विदेशी विनिमय कारोबार नियमन गर्ने ऐन कुन हो?
explanation: Foreign exchange transactions in Nepal are regulated under the Foreign Exchange (Regulation) Act, 2019 BS (1962).
explanation_ne: नेपालमा विदेशी विनिमय कारोबार विदेशी विनिमय (नियमन) ऐन, २०१९ वि.सं. (सन् १९६२) अन्तर्गत नियमन हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What did NRB abolish in December 2025 regarding fixed deposit interest rates?
question_ne: निश्चित निक्षेप ब्याजदरसम्बन्धी राष्ट्र बैंकले डिसेम्बर २०२५ मा के खारेज गर्‍यो?
options: The mandatory 1 percentage point spread between institutional and individual fixed deposit rates
options_ne: संस्थागत र व्यक्तिगत निश्चित निक्षेप दरबीचको अनिवार्य १ प्रतिशत बिन्दुको अन्तर
explanation: In December 2025 NRB abolished the rule requiring institutional fixed deposit rates to be at least 1 percentage point lower than individual fixed deposit rates, easing banks' cost pressure.
explanation_ne: डिसेम्बर २०२५ मा राष्ट्र बैंकले संस्थागत निश्चित निक्षेप दर व्यक्तिगत दरभन्दा कम्तीमा १ प्रतिशत बिन्दु कम हुनुपर्ने नियम खारेज गर्‍यो, जसले बैंकहरूको लागत दबाब कम गर्‍यो।

question: What does 'lender of last resort' mean for a central bank?
question_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकका लागि 'अन्तिम ऋणदाता' को अर्थ के हो?
options: It lends to banks facing temporary liquidity shortages when no one else will
It lends only to the government
It is the last bank to open in a country
It lends to foreign banks only
options_ne: अरू कसैले नदिँदा अस्थायी तरलता अभाव भएका बैंकहरूलाई ऋण दिनु
explanation: As lender of last resort, the central bank provides emergency funds to solvent banks facing temporary liquidity shortages, typically at the bank rate.
explanation_ne: अन्तिम ऋणदाताका रूपमा केन्द्रीय बैंकले अस्थायी तरलता अभाव भएका तर शोधक्षम बैंकहरूलाई आपत्कालीन रकम उपलब्ध गराउँछ, सामान्यतया बैंक दरमा।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is a 'bull market' in the stock market?
question_ne: सेयर बजारमा 'बुल मार्केट' भनेको के हो?
options: A market in which prices are rising
A market in which prices are falling
explanation: A bull market is a market in which share prices are rising (a bear market is one in which prices are falling).
explanation_ne: बुल मार्केट भनेको सेयर मूल्य बढिरहेको बजार हो (बियर मार्केटमा मूल्य घटिरहेको हुन्छ)।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is a 'bear market' in the stock market?
question_ne: सेयर बजारमा 'बियर मार्केट' भनेको के हो?
options: A market in which prices are falling
A market in which prices are rising
A market for new shares only
explanation: A bear market is a market in which share prices are falling over a sustained period.
explanation_ne: बियर मार्केट भनेको लामो समयसम्म सेयर मूल्य घटिरहेको बजार हो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the Price-to-Earnings (P/E) ratio?
question_ne: मूल्य-आम्दानी (P/E) अनुपात के हो?
options: Share price divided by earnings per share
Market value divided by book value
explanation: The P/E ratio is the share price divided by earnings per share (EPS); it shows how much investors pay for each rupee of earnings.
explanation_ne: P/E अनुपात सेयर मूल्यलाई प्रतिसेयर आम्दानी (EPS) ले भाग गरेर निकालिन्छ; यसले लगानीकर्ताले प्रत्येक रुपैयाँ आम्दानीका लागि कति तिरिरहेका छन् भन्ने देखाउँछ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is market capitalisation of a listed company?
question_ne: सूचीकृत कम्पनीको बजार पुँजीकरण (market capitalisation) के हो?
options: Total number of shares multiplied by the current market price per share
Total dividend paid in a year
options_ne: कुल सेयर सङ्ख्या गुणा प्रतिसेयर हालको बजार मूल्य
एक वर्षमा भुक्तान गरिएको कुल लाभांश
explanation: Market capitalisation is the total market value of a company: the number of outstanding shares multiplied by the current share price.
explanation_ne: बजार पुँजीकरण भनेको कम्पनीको कुल बजार मूल्य हो: बाँकी सेयर सङ्ख्या गुणा हालको सेयर मूल्य।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Which financial statement shows a company's financial position at a particular date?
question_ne: कुन वित्तीय विवरणले कुनै निश्चित मितिमा कम्पनीको वित्तीय स्थिति देखाउँछ?
explanation: The Balance Sheet shows a company's financial position (assets, liabilities and equity) at a particular date.
explanation_ne: वासलातले कुनै निश्चित मितिमा कम्पनीको वित्तीय स्थिति (सम्पत्ति, दायित्व र इक्विटी) देखाउँछ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Which financial statement shows a company's profit or loss over a period of time?
question_ne: कुन वित्तीय विवरणले निश्चित अवधिमा कम्पनीको नाफा वा नोक्सान देखाउँछ?
explanation: The Income Statement (Profit and Loss Account) shows revenues, expenses and profit or loss over a period.
explanation_ne: आय विवरण (नाफा-नोक्सान खाता) ले निश्चित अवधिको आम्दानी, खर्च र नाफा वा नोक्सान देखाउँछ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: In double-entry bookkeeping, every transaction affects at least how many accounts?
question_ne: दोहोरो लेखा प्रणालीमा प्रत्येक कारोबारले कम्तीमा कतिवटा खातालाई असर गर्छ?
explanation: In double-entry bookkeeping, every transaction affects at least two accounts — one debit and one credit of equal amount.
explanation_ne: दोहोरो लेखा प्रणालीमा प्रत्येक कारोबारले कम्तीमा दुई खातालाई असर गर्छ — एउटा डेबिट र बराबर रकमको एउटा क्रेडिट।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: Which of the following is a current liability?
question_ne: तलकामध्ये कुन चालु दायित्व हो?
explanation: Creditors (accounts payable) are current liabilities, payable within a year; long-term loans, debentures and share capital are non-current.
explanation_ne: साहू (भुक्तान गर्नुपर्ने खाता) चालु दायित्व हो, एक वर्षभित्र भुक्तान गर्नुपर्ने; दीर्घकालीन ऋण, डिबेन्चर र सेयर पुँजी गैर-चालु हुन्।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the compound interest on Rs 10,000 at 10% per annum for 2 years?
question_ne: रू १०,००० को १०% वार्षिक दरमा २ वर्षको चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज कति हुन्छ?
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the amount after 2 years if Rs 50,000 is deposited at 8% simple interest per annum?
question_ne: रू ५०,००० लाई ८% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याजमा २ वर्षका लागि जम्मा गर्दा मिश्रधन कति हुन्छ?
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the difference between a bearer cheque and an order cheque?
question_ne: वाहक चेक (bearer cheque) र आदेश चेक (order cheque) बीच के भिन्नता छ?
options: A bearer cheque is payable to whoever holds it; an order cheque is payable only to the named person or their order
A bearer cheque needs two signatures; an order cheque needs one
A bearer cheque is always crossed; an order cheque is never crossed
options_ne: वाहक चेक जसले बोकेको छ उसलाई भुक्तानी हुन्छ; आदेश चेक नाम उल्लेख भएको व्यक्ति वा उसको आदेशमा मात्र भुक्तानी हुन्छ
वाहक चेकमा दुई हस्ताक्षर चाहिन्छ; आदेश चेकमा एउटा
वाहक चेक सधैं क्रस हुन्छ; आदेश चेक कहिल्यै क्रस हुँदैन
explanation: A bearer cheque is payable to whoever presents it, while an order cheque is payable only to the person named on it (or to someone they endorse it to).
explanation_ne: वाहक चेक जसले प्रस्तुत गर्छ उसलाई भुक्तानी हुन्छ, जबकि आदेश चेकमा नाम उल्लेख भएको व्यक्ति (वा उसले समर्थन गरेको व्यक्ति) लाई मात्र भुक्तानी हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What does EMI stand for?
question_ne: EMI को पूरा रूप के हो?
explanation: EMI stands for Equated Monthly Instalment — the fixed monthly payment of principal plus interest on a loan.
explanation_ne: EMI को अर्थ Equated Monthly Instalment हो — कर्जाको मूलधन र ब्याजको निश्चित मासिक भुक्तानी।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What does SWIFT stand for in international banking?
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय बैंकिङमा SWIFT को पूरा रूप के हो?
options: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication
System for Worldwide Interbank Fund Transfer
Society for World Interbank Financial Trade
options_ne: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication
System for Worldwide Interbank Fund Transfer
Society for World Interbank Financial Trade
explanation: SWIFT stands for Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication — the global network banks use for secure cross-border payment messages.
explanation_ne: SWIFT को अर्थ Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication हो — बैंकहरूले सुरक्षित सीमापार भुक्तानी सन्देशका लागि प्रयोग गर्ने विश्वव्यापी सञ्जाल।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is a Letter of Credit (LC) in international trade?
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय व्यापारमा प्रतीतपत्र (Letter of Credit) भनेको के हो?
options: A bank's written guarantee to pay the exporter if the importer fails to pay
A letter written by the importer to the exporter
options_ne: आयातकर्ताले भुक्तानी नगरे निर्यातकर्तालाई भुक्तानी गर्ने बैंकको लिखित ग्यारेन्टी
explanation: A Letter of Credit is a bank's written commitment to pay the exporter a specified amount if the documents and conditions are met, reducing trade risk.
explanation_ne: प्रतीतपत्र भनेको कागजात र सर्तहरू पूरा भए निर्यातकर्तालाई निर्दिष्ट रकम भुक्तानी गर्ने बैंकको लिखित प्रतिबद्धता हो, जसले व्यापार जोखिम कम गर्छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund (DCGF) in Nepal, and how much deposit does it insure per depositor per bank?
question_ne: नेपालको निक्षेप तथा कर्जा सुरक्षण कोष (DCGF) के हो र यसले प्रति निक्षेपकर्ता प्रति बैंक कति निक्षेपको बीमा गर्छ?
options: It insures deposits up to Rs 500,000 per depositor per bank
It insures deposits up to Rs 100,000 per depositor per bank
It insures all deposits without limit
It insures loans up to Rs 500,000 only
options_ne: यसले प्रति निक्षेपकर्ता प्रति बैंक रू ५,००,००० सम्मको निक्षेपको बीमा गर्छ
यसले प्रति निक्षेपकर्ता प्रति बैंक रू १,००,००० सम्मको निक्षेपको बीमा गर्छ
यसले सबै निक्षेपको सीमाविना बीमा गर्छ
यसले रू ५,००,००० सम्मको कर्जाको मात्र बीमा गर्छ
explanation: The Deposit and Credit Guarantee Fund insures bank deposits up to Rs 500,000 per depositor per bank, protecting small depositors if a bank fails.
explanation_ne: निक्षेप तथा कर्जा सुरक्षण कोषले बैंक असफल भएमा साना निक्षेपकर्ताहरूको सुरक्षा गर्दै प्रति निक्षेपकर्ता प्रति बैंक रू ५,००,००० सम्मको निक्षेपको बीमा गर्छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: When was the IMF founded, and where is its headquarters?
question_ne: IMF कहिले स्थापना भयो र यसको मुख्यालय कहाँ छ?
explanation: The International Monetary Fund was founded in 1944 at Bretton Woods and is headquartered in Washington DC.
explanation_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मुद्रा कोष सन् १९४४ मा ब्रेटन वुड्समा स्थापना भएको थियो र यसको मुख्यालय वासिङ्टन डीसीमा छ।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What does AML/CFT stand for in banking regulation?
question_ne: बैंक नियमनमा AML/CFT को पूरा रूप के हो?
options: Anti-Money Laundering / Combating the Financing of Terrorism
Asset Management Law / Credit Finance Tax
Approved Money Lending / Certified Fund Transfer
options_ne: सम्पत्ति शुद्धीकरण निवारण / आतङ्कवादमा वित्तीय लगानी निवारण
सम्पत्ति व्यवस्थापन कानुन / कर्जा वित्त कर
स्वीकृत मुद्रा ऋण / प्रमाणित कोष हस्तान्तरण
explanation: AML/CFT stands for Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism — weak AML/CFT enforcement was why FATF grey-listed Nepal in February 2025.
explanation_ne: AML/CFT को अर्थ Anti-Money Laundering (सम्पत्ति शुद्धीकरण निवारण) र Combating the Financing of Terrorism (आतङ्कवादमा वित्तीय लगानी निवारण) हो — कमजोर AML/CFT कार्यान्वयनकै कारण FATF ले फेब्रुअरी २०२५ मा नेपाललाई खैरो सूचीमा राखेको थियो।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What is the main purpose of the Economic Survey published annually by Nepal's Ministry of Finance?
question_ne: नेपालको अर्थ मन्त्रालयले वार्षिक रूपमा प्रकाशित गर्ने आर्थिक सर्वेक्षणको मुख्य उद्देश्य के हो?
options: To review the country's economic performance before the budget
options_ne: बजेटअघि देशको आर्थिक कार्यसम्पादनको समीक्षा गर्नु
explanation: The Economic Survey reviews Nepal's economic performance over the past year and is presented by the Finance Minister just before the annual budget (e.g. it forecast 4.61% growth for FY 2081/82).
explanation_ne: आर्थिक सर्वेक्षणले गत वर्षको नेपालको आर्थिक कार्यसम्पादनको समीक्षा गर्छ र अर्थमन्त्रीले वार्षिक बजेटअघि प्रस्तुत गर्छन् (जस्तै यसले आ.व. २०८१/८२ का लागि ४.६१% वृद्धि अनुमान गरेको थियो)।
source: Nepal Rastra Bank / SEBON / लोक सेवा पाठ्यक्रम

question: What term, referring to politicians' children flaunting luxury lifestyles, helped trigger Nepal's 2025 Gen Z protests?
question_ne: नेताका छोराछोरीले विलासी जीवनशैली देखाएको भन्दै नेपालको २०२५ को जेन-जी आन्दोलन भड्काउन मद्दत गरेको शब्द कुन हो?
explanation: Social media posts about 'nepo kids' — politicians' children flaunting luxury lifestyles — helped fuel anger ahead of the September 2025 Gen Z protests.
explanation_ne: नेताका छोराछोरीले विलासी जीवनशैली देखाएको 'नेपो किड्स' सम्बन्धी सामाजिक सञ्जालका पोस्टहरूले २०२५ सेप्टेम्बरको जेन-जी आन्दोलनअघि आक्रोश बढाउन मद्दत गरे।

question: According to Reuters in March 2026, approximately how many people had died in Nepal's Gen Z protests?
question_ne: मार्च २०२६ मा रोयटर्सका अनुसार नेपालको जेन-जी आन्दोलनमा लगभग कति जनाको मृत्यु भएको थियो?
explanation: Reuters reported in March 2026 that the Gen Z protest death toll stood at about 77 people.
explanation_ne: रोयटर्सले मार्च २०२६ मा जेन-जी आन्दोलनमा मृत्यु हुनेको सङ्ख्या लगभग ७७ पुगेको जनाएको थियो।

question: Approximately how many people leave Nepal every day for foreign employment?
question_ne: वैदेशिक रोजगारीका लागि नेपालबाट हरेक दिन लगभग कति जना बाहिरिन्छन्?
explanation: About 1,500 people leave Nepal every day for foreign work, reflecting the country's heavy dependence on labour migration and remittances.
explanation_ne: वैदेशिक रोजगारी र रेमिट्यान्समा देशको ठूलो निर्भरता देखाउँदै नेपालबाट हरेक दिन लगभग १,५०० जना वैदेशिक कामका लागि बाहिरिन्छन्।

question: About what share of Nepal's population of roughly 30 million lives in poverty?
question_ne: नेपालको लगभग ३ करोड जनसङ्ख्यामध्ये कति भाग गरिबीमा बाँचिरहेको छ?
explanation: About a fifth of Nepal's roughly 30 million people live in poverty, a driver of the frustration behind the 2025 protests.
explanation_ne: नेपालको लगभग ३ करोड जनसङ्ख्यामध्ये लगभग पाँच भागमध्ये एक भाग गरिबीमा बाँचिरहेको छ, जुन २०२५ को आन्दोलनपछिको निराशाको एउटा कारण हो।

question: Before becoming Nepal's first woman Prime Minister in 2025, Sushila Karki had served as the country's first woman Chief Justice during which years?
question_ne: सन् २०२५ मा नेपालकी पहिलो महिला प्रधानमन्त्री बन्नुअघि सुशीला कार्कीले कुन वर्षहरूमा देशकी पहिलो महिला प्रधानन्यायाधीशका रूपमा सेवा गरेकी थिइन्?
explanation: Sushila Karki was Nepal's first woman Chief Justice in 2016-2017, and in September 2025 she became the country's first woman Prime Minister.
explanation_ne: सुशीला कार्की सन् २०१६-२०१७ मा नेपालकी पहिलो महिला प्रधानन्यायाधीश थिइन् र सेप्टेम्बर २०२५ मा उनी देशकी पहिलो महिला प्रधानमन्त्री बनिन्।

question: How many of the 15 constituencies in the Kathmandu Valley did the Rastriya Swatantra Party win in the March 2026 election?
question_ne: मार्च २०२६ को निर्वाचनमा राष्ट्रिय स्वतन्त्र पार्टीले काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका १५ निर्वाचन क्षेत्रमध्ये कति जित्यो?
explanation: The RSP won a clean sweep of all 15 Kathmandu Valley constituencies in the March 2026 election, including all 10 seats in Kathmandu district.
explanation_ne: रास्वपाले मार्च २०२६ को निर्वाचनमा काठमाडौं जिल्लाका सबै १० सिटसहित काठमाडौं उपत्यकाका सबै १५ निर्वाचन क्षेत्र जित्यो।

question: In the Jhapa-5 contest of March 2026, how many votes did KP Sharma Oli receive against Balendra Shah's 68,348?
question_ne: मार्च २०२६ को झापा-५ को प्रतिस्पर्धामा बालेन्द्र शाहको ६८,३४८ मतको तुलनामा केपी शर्मा ओलीले कति मत पाए?
explanation: Balendra Shah defeated KP Sharma Oli in Jhapa-5 by about 50,000 votes — 68,348 to Oli's 18,734 — in the March 2026 election.
explanation_ne: मार्च २०२६ को निर्वाचनमा बालेन्द्र शाहले झापा-५ मा केपी शर्मा ओलीलाई लगभग ५०,००० मतले पराजित गरे — शाहको ६८,३४८ विरुद्ध ओलीको १८,७३४ मत।

question: Before entering national politics, Balendra Shah was elected mayor of which city as an independent in May 2022?
question_ne: राष्ट्रिय राजनीतिमा प्रवेश गर्नुअघि बालेन्द्र शाह मे २०२२ मा स्वतन्त्र रूपमा कुन सहरको मेयर निर्वाचित भएका थिए?
explanation: Balendra Shah, a rapper-turned-politician, was elected mayor of Kathmandu as an independent in May 2022 before winning the 2026 general election.
explanation_ne: र्‍यापरबाट राजनीतिज्ञ बनेका बालेन्द्र शाह २०२६ को आम निर्वाचन जित्नुअघि मे २०२२ मा स्वतन्त्र रूपमा काठमाडौं महानगरपालिकाको मेयर निर्वाचित भएका थिए।

question: Baburam Bhattarai withdrew his candidacy from which constituency ahead of the March 2026 election?
question_ne: मार्च २०२६ को निर्वाचनअघि बाबुराम भट्टराईले कुन निर्वाचन क्षेत्रबाट आफ्नो उम्मेदवारी फिर्ता लिए?
explanation: Former Prime Minister Baburam Bhattarai withdrew from the Gorkha-2 race ahead of the March 2026 general election.
explanation_ne: पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री बाबुराम भट्टराईले मार्च २०२६ को आम निर्वाचनअघि गोरखा-२ बाट आफ्नो उम्मेदवारी फिर्ता लिएका थिए।

question: Mahabir Pun won Myagdi-1 in the March 2026 election as what kind of candidate, with the RSP fielding no candidate against him?
question_ne: महावीर पुनले मार्च २०२६ को निर्वाचनमा म्याग्दी-१ बाट कस्तो उम्मेदवारका रूपमा जिते, जहाँ रास्वपाले उनीविरुद्ध उम्मेदवार उठाएको थिएन?
explanation: Mahabir Pun, the education minister in the interim government, won Myagdi-1 as an independent in March 2026; the RSP fielded no candidate against him.
explanation_ne: अन्तरिम सरकारका शिक्षामन्त्री महावीर पुनले मार्च २०२६ मा म्याग्दी-१ बाट स्वतन्त्र रूपमा जिते; रास्वपाले उनीविरुद्ध उम्मेदवार उठाएको थिएन।

question: An investigation panel into the 2025 crackdown recommended the prosecution of those responsible, including which former Prime Minister?
question_ne: २०२५ को दमनबारेको छानबिन समितिले कुन पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्रीसहित जिम्मेवारहरूको अभियोजन सिफारिस गर्‍यो?
explanation: The investigation panel into the September 2025 crackdown recommended prosecution of those responsible, including former Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli.
explanation_ne: सेप्टेम्बर २०२५ को दमनबारेको छानबिन समितिले पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री केपी शर्मा ओलीसहित जिम्मेवारहरूको अभियोजन सिफारिस गर्‍यो।

question: Who congratulated Nepal's new government on 7 March 2026, two days after the general election?
question_ne: आम निर्वाचनको दुई दिनपछि, २०२६ मार्च ७ मा नेपालको नयाँ सरकारलाई कसले बधाई दिए?
explanation: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated Nepal's new government on 7 March 2026, two days after the election results.
explanation_ne: भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीले निर्वाचन परिणामको दुई दिनपछि, २०२६ मार्च ७ मा नेपालको नयाँ सरकारलाई बधाई दिए।

question: How many seats did the smaller Madhesh-based regional parties win in Nepal's March 2026 general election?
question_ne: नेपालको मार्च २०२६ को आम निर्वाचनमा साना मधेशकेन्द्रित क्षेत्रीय दलहरूले कति सिट जिते?
explanation: The smaller Madhesh-based regional groups won no seats at all in the March 2026 election, as the RSP swept the polls.
explanation_ne: साना मधेशकेन्द्रित क्षेत्रीय समूहहरूले मार्च २०२६ को निर्वाचनमा एउटा पनि सिट जितेनन्, किनकि रास्वपाले निर्वाचनमा ठूलो जित हासिल गर्‍यो।

question: What distinctive items did Balendra Shah wear at his swearing-in as Prime Minister on 27 March 2026?
question_ne: २७ मार्च २०२६ मा प्रधानमन्त्रीका रूपमा शपथ लिँदा बालेन्द्र शाहले कस्ता विशिष्ट वस्तु लगाएका थिए?
options: Signature black Nepali topi and sunglasses
explanation: Balendra Shah wore his signature black Nepali topi and sunglasses at his swearing-in as Prime Minister on 27 March 2026.
explanation_ne: बालेन्द्र शाहले २७ मार्च २०२६ मा प्रधानमन्त्रीका रूपमा शपथ लिँदा आफ्नो विशिष्ट कालो नेपाली टोपी र सनग्लास लगाएका थिए।

question: What is the majority mark — the number of seats needed for a majority — in Nepal's 275-member House of Representatives?
question_ne: नेपालको २७५ सदस्यीय प्रतिनिधिसभामा बहुमतका लागि आवश्यक सिट सङ्ख्या (बहुमतको अंक) कति हो?
explanation: A party needs 138 of the 275 seats for a majority in Nepal's House of Representatives; the RSP won 182 in March 2026.
explanation_ne: नेपालको प्रतिनिधिसभामा बहुमतका लागि २७५ मध्ये १३८ सिट चाहिन्छ; रास्वपाले मार्च २०२६ मा १८२ सिट जित्यो।

question: How much did Nepal's FY 2082/83 budget allocate for subsidised startup loans, and at what interest rate?
question_ne: नेपालको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को बजेटले सहुलियतपूर्ण स्टार्टअप ऋणका लागि कति रकम र कुन ब्याजदरमा छुट्यायो?
explanation: The FY 2082/83 budget allocated Rs 730 million in subsidised loans for startups at 3% interest.
explanation_ne: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को बजेटले स्टार्टअपहरूका लागि ३% ब्याजदरमा रू ७३० मिलियन सहुलियतपूर्ण ऋण छुट्यायो।

question: Nepal's FY 2082/83 budget announced free visas for which group to promote education and tourism?
question_ne: नेपालको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को बजेटले शिक्षा र पर्यटन प्रवर्द्धनका लागि कुन समूहलाई निःशुल्क भिसा दिने घोषणा गर्‍यो?
explanation: The FY 2082/83 budget announced free visas for foreign students coming to study in Nepal.
explanation_ne: आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को बजेटले नेपालमा अध्ययन गर्न आउने विदेशी विद्यार्थीहरूलाई निःशुल्क भिसा दिने घोषणा गर्‍यो।

question: What is the foreign exchange limit for Nepali travellers going abroad, as set in NRB's FY 2082/83 monetary policy?
question_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को मौद्रिक नीतिअनुसार विदेश जाने नेपाली यात्रीहरूका लागि विदेशी मुद्रा सीमा कति छ?
explanation: NRB's FY 2082/83 monetary policy kept the travel foreign exchange facility at USD 3,000 per traveller.
explanation_ne: नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ को मौद्रिक नीतिले यात्रीका लागि विदेशी मुद्रा सुविधा अमेरिकी डलर ३,००० मा कायम राख्यो।

question: Fill in the blank: I wish I ___ rich so that I could help the poor.

question: Fill in the blank: If only he ___ harder, he would have passed the exam.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: If only he ___ harder, he would have passed the exam.

explanation_ne: अवास्तविक भूतकालीन इच्छाका लागि 'if only' पछि past perfect प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'If only he had studied harder...'
source: English grammar: if only + past perfect

question: Fill in the blank: It is high time we ___ home.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: It is high time we ___ home.
explanation: 'It is high time' is followed by the past subjunctive: 'It is high time we went home.'
explanation_ne: 'It is high time' पछि भूतकालीन सम्भाव्य रूप प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'It is high time we went home.'
source: English grammar: it is time + past subjunctive

question: Fill in the blank: He talks as if he ___ everything.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He talks as if he ___ everything.
explanation: After 'as if' for an unreal situation, the past subjunctive is used: 'He talks as if he knew everything.'
explanation_ne: अवास्तविक अवस्थाका लागि 'as if' पछि भूतकालीन सम्भाव्य रूप प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'He talks as if he knew everything.'
source: English grammar: as if + past subjunctive

question: Fill in the blank: You ___ hurry; the train leaves in ten minutes.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: You ___ hurry; the train leaves in ten minutes.
explanation: 'Had better' + base verb gives strong advice: 'You had better hurry.' 'Would rather' expresses preference, not advice.

question: Fill in the blank: He ___ swim very well when he was young.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He ___ swim very well when he was young.
explanation: For past ability, 'could' is used: 'He could swim very well when he was young.'
explanation_ne: भूतकालीन क्षमताका लागि 'could' प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'He could swim very well when he was young.'
source: English grammar: could for past ability

question: Fill in the blank: You ___ smoke here; it is strictly prohibited.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: You ___ smoke here; it is strictly prohibited.
explanation: 'Must not' expresses prohibition: 'You must not smoke here.' 'Need not' means it is not necessary, which is different.
explanation_ne: निषेधका लागि 'must not' प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'You must not smoke here.' 'Need not' को अर्थ 'आवश्यक छैन' हो, जुन फरक छ।
source: English grammar: must not vs need not

question: Fill in the blank: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset before.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset before.
explanation: When a negative adverb like 'never' begins a sentence, the auxiliary comes before the subject: 'Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.'
explanation_ne: 'Never' जस्तो नकारात्मक क्रियाविशेषण वाक्यको सुरुमा आएमा सहायक क्रिया कर्ताअघि आउँछ: 'Never have I seen...'

question: Fill in the blank: Not only ___ the exam, but he also stood first in the class.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: Not only ___ the exam, but he also stood first in the class.
explanation: 'Not only' at the start of a clause triggers inversion: 'Not only did he pass the exam, but he also stood first.'
explanation_ne: वाक्यको सुरुमा 'Not only' आएमा उल्टो क्रम हुन्छ: 'Not only did he pass the exam...'

question: Fill in the blank: Had I known the truth, I ___ helped you.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: Had I known the truth, I ___ helped you.
explanation: In the inverted third conditional, 'Had I known the truth, I would have helped you' is correct.
explanation_ne: उल्टो क्रमको तेस्रो सर्तमा 'Had I known the truth, I would have helped you' सही हुन्छ।

question: Fill in the blank: Seldom ___ such an honest officer.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: Seldom ___ such an honest officer.
explanation: 'Seldom' at the start of a sentence requires inversion: 'Seldom have I met such an honest officer.'
explanation_ne: वाक्यको सुरुमा 'Seldom' आएमा उल्टो क्रम आवश्यक हुन्छ: 'Seldom have I met such an honest officer.'

question: Choose the correct question tag: I am your best friend, ___?
question_ne: सही प्रश्न ट्याग छान्नुहोस्: I am your best friend, ___?
explanation: The tag for 'I am' is 'aren't I': 'I am your best friend, aren't I?'
explanation_ne: 'I am' को प्रश्न ट्याग 'aren't I' हुन्छ: 'I am your best friend, aren't I?'

question: Choose the correct question tag: Nobody came to the meeting, ___?
question_ne: सही प्रश्न ट्याग छान्नुहोस्: Nobody came to the meeting, ___?
explanation: 'Nobody' is negative, so the tag is positive and plural: 'Nobody came to the meeting, did they?'
explanation_ne: 'Nobody' नकारात्मक भएकाले ट्याग सकारात्मक र बहुवचन हुन्छ: 'Nobody came to the meeting, did they?'

question: Choose the correct question tag: He hardly works, ___?
question_ne: सही प्रश्न ट्याग छान्नुहोस्: He hardly works, ___?
explanation: 'Hardly' makes the sentence negative in sense, so the tag is positive: 'He hardly works, does he?'
explanation_ne: 'Hardly' ले वाक्यलाई अर्थमा नकारात्मक बनाउँछ, त्यसैले ट्याग सकारात्मक हुन्छ: 'He hardly works, does he?'

question: Fill in the blank: She suggested ___ to the library after lunch.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: She suggested ___ to the library after lunch.
explanation: 'Suggest' is followed by a gerund: 'She suggested going to the library.' (Note: 'suggest + object + to-infinitive' is wrong.)
explanation_ne: 'Suggest' पछि gerund आउँछ: 'She suggested going to the library.'

question: Fill in the blank: I look forward to ___ you soon.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: I look forward to ___ you soon.
explanation: In 'look forward to', 'to' is a preposition, so a gerund follows: 'I look forward to seeing you soon.'
explanation_ne: 'Look forward to' मा 'to' पूर्वसर्ग हो, त्यसैले पछि gerund आउँछ: 'I look forward to seeing you soon.'
source: English grammar: look forward to + gerund

question: Fill in the blank: He is capable of ___ the work alone.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He is capable of ___ the work alone.
explanation: 'Capable of' is followed by a gerund: 'He is capable of doing the work alone.'
explanation_ne: 'Capable of' पछि gerund आउँछ: 'He is capable of doing the work alone.'

question: Fill in the blank: I cannot help ___ at his jokes.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: I cannot help ___ at his jokes.
explanation: 'Cannot help' is followed by a gerund: 'I cannot help laughing at his jokes.'
explanation_ne: 'Cannot help' पछि gerund आउँछ: 'I cannot help laughing at his jokes.'

question: Fill in the blank: I remember ___ the door before I left.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: I remember ___ the door before I left.
explanation: 'Remember + gerund' refers to a past action already done: 'I remember locking the door.' ('Remember to lock' would mean not forgetting a future action.)
explanation_ne: 'Remember + gerund' ले गरिसकेको विगतको काम जनाउँछ: 'I remember locking the door.'

question: Fill in the blank: Don't forget ___ the letter tomorrow.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: Don't forget ___ the letter tomorrow.
explanation: 'Forget + to-infinitive' refers to a future action not to be missed: 'Don't forget to post the letter tomorrow.'
explanation_ne: 'Forget + to-infinitive' ले भविष्यमा गर्नुपर्ने काम जनाउँछ: 'Don't forget to post the letter tomorrow.'

question: Fill in the blank: He stopped ___ to a friend on the way home.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He stopped ___ to a friend on the way home.
explanation: 'Stop + to-infinitive' means stopping in order to do something else: 'He stopped to talk to a friend.' ('Stop talking' would mean ceasing the talk.)
explanation_ne: 'Stop + to-infinitive' को अर्थ अर्को काम गर्न रोकिनु हो: 'He stopped to talk to a friend.'

question: Fill in the blank: I regret ___ you that the meeting has been cancelled.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: I regret ___ you that the meeting has been cancelled.
explanation: 'Regret + to-infinitive' is used to announce bad news: 'I regret to inform you that the meeting has been cancelled.'
explanation_ne: खराब खबर सुनाउन 'regret + to-infinitive' प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'I regret to inform you...'

question: Fill in the blank: I had my house ___ by a painter last month.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: I had my house ___ by a painter last month.
explanation: The causative 'have something done' uses the past participle: 'I had my house painted by a painter.'
explanation_ne: कारक रूप 'have something done' मा past participle प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'I had my house painted...'

question: Fill in the blank: She got her car ___ at the garage yesterday.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: She got her car ___ at the garage yesterday.
explanation: The causative 'get something done' uses the past participle: 'She got her car repaired at the garage.'
explanation_ne: कारक रूप 'get something done' मा past participle प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'She got her car repaired...'

question: Fill in the blank: The committee ___ unanimous in its decision.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: The committee ___ unanimous in its decision.
explanation: When a collective noun acts as a single unit, it takes a singular verb: 'The committee is unanimous in its decision.' (If members act separately — 'are divided' — a plural verb is used.)
explanation_ne: समूहवाचक नाम एउटै इकाइका रूपमा कार्य गर्दा एकवचन क्रिया लाग्छ: 'The committee is unanimous...' (सदस्यहरू अलग-अलग कार्य गर्दा — 'are divided' — बहुवचन क्रिया प्रयोग हुन्छ।)

question: Fill in the blank: He is ___ M.A. in English.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He is ___ M.A. in English.

question: Fill in the blank: ___ Himalayas lie to the north of Nepal.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: ___ Himalayas lie to the north of Nepal.
explanation: Mountain ranges take the definite article: 'The Himalayas lie to the north of Nepal.'
explanation_ne: पर्वत शृङ्खलाअघि निश्चित अनुच्छेद 'the' आउँछ: 'The Himalayas lie to the north of Nepal.'
source: English grammar: articles with geographical names

question: Fill in the blank: I have ___ money left; I cannot lend you any.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: I have ___ money left; I cannot lend you any.
explanation: 'Little' (almost none) fits the negative sense here: 'I have little money left.' 'A little' would mean some money, which contradicts the second clause.

source: English grammar: little vs a little

question: Fill in the blank: ___ students in the class passed the exam, so the teacher was pleased.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: ___ students in the class passed the exam, so the teacher was pleased.
explanation: 'A few' means 'some' (a positive sense), which fits the teacher being pleased: 'A few students passed the exam.' 'Few' would mean almost none, contradicting the teacher's pleasure.
explanation_ne: 'A few' को अर्थ 'केही' (सकारात्मक) हो, जुन शिक्षक खुसी भएकोसँग मेल खान्छ: 'A few students passed the exam.' 'Few' को अर्थ 'लगभग कोही छैन' हुन्छ।
source: English grammar: few vs a few

question: Fill in the blank: The train will arrive ___ 6 o'clock.

explanation_ne: घडीको समयसँग 'at' प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'The train will arrive at 6 o'clock.'

question: Fill in the blank: He was born ___ 15th July 2000.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He was born ___ 15th July 2000.
explanation: 'On' is used with a specific date: 'He was born on 15th July 2000.'
explanation_ne: निर्दिष्ट मितिसँग 'on' प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'He was born on 15th July 2000.'

question: Fill in the blank: He agreed ___ my proposal after much discussion.
question_ne: खाली ठाउँ भर्नुहोस्: He agreed ___ my proposal after much discussion.
explanation: 'Agree to' is used with a proposal/plan; 'agree with' is used with a person: 'He agreed to my proposal.'
explanation_ne: प्रस्ताव/योजनासँग 'agree to' र व्यक्तिसँग 'agree with' प्रयोग हुन्छ: 'He agreed to my proposal.'
source: English grammar: agree to vs agree with

question: Fill in the blank: The book consists ___ ten chapters.

explanation: 'Consist of' means to be made up of: 'The book consists of ten chapters.'
explanation_ne: 'Consist of' को अर्थ 'बनेको हुनु' हो: 'The book consists of ten chapters.'

question: Fill in the blank: He died ___ overwork, not ___ disease.

question: Fill in the blank: If you had listened to me, you ___ in trouble now.

question: Fill in the blank: Provided that you pay in advance, we ___ deliver the goods tomorrow.

explanation_ne: 'Provided that' ले पहिलो सर्तको शर्त जनाउँछ: 'Provided that you pay in advance, we will deliver the goods tomorrow.'

question: Choose the correct passive voice of: 'Let him do the work.'

question: Choose the correct indirect speech of: He said, 'I have finished my homework.'

question: Find the error: 'One of the boys have gone home.'
question_ne: त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्: 'One of the boys have gone home.'

question: Find the error: 'The informations are very useful.'
question_ne: त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्: 'The informations are very useful.'
explanation: 'Information' is uncountable and has no plural: 'The information is very useful.' The error is 'informations'.
explanation_ne: 'Information' अगणनीय नाम हो र यसको बहुवचन हुँदैन: 'The information is very useful.' त्रुटि 'informations' मा छ।

question: Find the error: 'He is more taller than his brother.'
question_ne: त्रुटि पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्: 'He is more taller than his brother.'
explanation: Double comparative is wrong: use 'taller' alone — 'He is taller than his brother.' The error is 'more taller'.
explanation_ne: दोहोरो तुलनात्मक रूप गलत हो: 'taller' मात्र प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् — 'He is taller than his brother.' त्रुटि 'more taller' मा छ।

question: Find the error: 'Neither Ram nor Shyam have come.'

explanation_ne: 'Neither...nor' मा दुवै कर्ता एकवचन भए एकवचन क्रिया लाग्छ: 'Neither Ram nor Shyam has come.' त्रुटि 'have' मा छ।

question: Find the error: 'I am going to school yesterday.'

explanation_ne: वर्तमान निरन्तर 'am going' भूतकालीन समय शब्द 'yesterday' सँग मेल खाँदैन; 'I went to school yesterday' हुनुपर्छ। त्रुटि 'am going' मा छ।

question: Choose the synonym of 'acumen'.

question: Choose the synonym of 'alleviate'.

question: Choose the synonym of 'animosity'.

question: Choose the synonym of 'apathy'.

question: Choose the synonym of 'ardent'.

question: In the sentence 'ऊ काठमाडौंमा बस्छ', what karak (कारक) is 'काठमाडौंमा'?

explanation: 'काठमाडौंमा' shows the place where he lives, so it is in the adhikarana karak (locative case).
explanation_ne: 'काठमाडौंमा' ले ऊ बस्ने ठाउँ जनाउँछ, त्यसैले यो अधिकरण कारक हो।

question: In the sentence 'गीता किताब पढ्छे', what karak (कारक) is 'गीता'?
question_ne: 'गीता किताब पढ्छे' वाक्यमा 'गीता' कुन कारक हो?
explanation: 'गीता' is the doer of the reading, so it is in the karta karak (nominative case).
explanation_ne: 'गीता' पढ्ने कर्ता हो, त्यसैले यो कर्तृ कारक हो।

question: Choose the synonym (पर्यायवाची) of 'रात'.

question: What does the proverb 'घरको बाघ वनको स्याल' mean?
question_ne: 'घरको बाघ वनको स्याल' उखानको अर्थ के हो?
options: A hero at home but a coward outside
explanation: 'घरको बाघ वनको स्याल' describes a person who is brave at home but cowardly outside.
explanation_ne: 'घरको बाघ वनको स्याल' भन्नाले घरमा वीर तर बाहिर डरपोक व्यक्ति भन्ने बुझिन्छ।

question: What does the proverb 'जुन जोगी आए पनि कानै चिरेको' mean?
question_ne: 'जुन जोगी आए पनि कानै चिरेको' उखानको अर्थ के हो?
options: The same thing in a different guise
explanation: 'जुन जोगी आए पनि कानै चिरेको' means the same thing in a different guise — a change of person without a change of substance.
explanation_ne: 'जुन जोगी आए पनि कानै चिरेको' भन्नाले व्यक्ति फेरिए पनि सार उही हुनु भन्ने बुझिन्छ।

question: What does the proverb 'नौ नगद न तेरह उधार' mean?
question_ne: 'नौ नगद न तेरह उधार' उखानको अर्थ के हो?
options: A bird in hand is worth two in the bush
Nine rupees are better than thirteen
Cash is always better than credit
options_ne: हातमा भएको नौ उधारोको तेह्रभन्दा राम्रो
explanation: 'नौ नगद न तेरह उधार' means that nine rupees in cash now is better than thirteen promised on credit — a bird in hand is worth two in the bush.
explanation_ne: 'नौ नगद न तेरह उधार' भन्नाले अहिले हातमा भएको नौ रुपियाँ उधारोमा पाउने तेह्र रुपियाँभन्दा राम्रो हो भन्ने बुझिन्छ।

question: What was the real name of the Nepali writer Parijat?

question: What is the feminine (स्त्रीलिङ्ग) form of 'विद्वान्'?

question: What is the feminine (स्त्रीलिङ्ग) form of 'नेता'?

question_ne: 'सुन्दर' शब्दमा कुन उपसर्ग प्रयोग भएको छ?
explanation: 'सुन्दर' is formed from the prefix 'सु' + 'न्दर' (good/beautiful).

question: What is the simple interest on Rs 200,000 at 6% per annum for 2 years?
question_ne: रू २,००,००० मा ६% वार्षिक दरले २ वर्षको साधारण ब्याज कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Simple interest = 200,000 × 6 × 2 / 100 = Rs 24,000.

question: What is the interest on Rs 10,000 at 10% per annum for 1 year if interest is compounded half-yearly?
question_ne: रू १०,००० मा १०% वार्षिक दरले १ वर्षका लागि अर्धवार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि गर्दा ब्याज कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Half-yearly rate is 5% for 2 periods: amount = 10,000 × (1.05)² = Rs 11,025, so interest = Rs 1,025.

question: A sum of money doubles itself in 8 years at simple interest. What is the annual rate of interest?
question_ne: कुनै रकम साधारण ब्याजमा ८ वर्षमा दोब्बर हुन्छ। वार्षिक ब्याजदर कति हो?
explanation: Interest equals the principal (100%) in 8 years, so the rate = 100 / 8 = 12.5% per annum.
explanation_ne: ८ वर्षमा ब्याज मूलधन बराबर (१००%) हुन्छ, त्यसैले दर = १०० / ८ = १२.५% वार्षिक।

question: What is the simple interest on Rs 150,000 at 10% per annum for 6 months?
question_ne: रू १,५०,००० मा १०% वार्षिक दरले ६ महिनाको साधारण ब्याज कति हुन्छ?

question: A shopkeeper buys an item for Rs 800 and sells it for Rs 1,000. What is the profit percentage?
question_ne: एक पसलेले रू ८०० मा किनेको सामान रू १,००० मा बेच्छन्। नाफा प्रतिशत कति हो?

question: A shop offers a 10% discount on an item marked Rs 5,000. What is the discount amount?
question_ne: एउटा पसलले रू ५,००० अङ्कित मूल्यको सामानमा १०% छुट दिन्छ। छुट रकम कति हो?
explanation: Discount = 10% of Rs 5,000 = Rs 500, so the selling price is Rs 4,500.

question: What is the monthly interest on a loan of Rs 120,000 at 12% per annum simple interest?
question_ne: १२% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याजदरमा रू १,२०,००० को ऋणमा मासिक ब्याज कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Annual interest = 120,000 × 12% = Rs 14,400; monthly interest = 14,400 / 12 = Rs 1,200.

question: What is the simple interest on Rs 60,000 at 9% per annum for 1 year?
question_ne: रू ६०,००० मा ९% वार्षिक दरले १ वर्षको साधारण ब्याज कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Simple interest = 60,000 × 9 × 1 / 100 = Rs 5,400.

question: What is a current account in a bank?
question_ne: बैंकमा चालु खाता भनेको के हो?
options: An account for frequent business transactions, with no interest and no limit on withdrawals
An account that pays the highest interest on savings
An account opened only for fixed deposits
options_ne: बारम्बार व्यापारिक कारोबारका लागि खाता, जसमा ब्याज दिइँदैन र निकासीमा सीमा हुँदैन
बचतमा सबैभन्दा बढी ब्याज दिने खाता
मुद्दती निक्षेपका लागि मात्र खोलिने खाता
explanation: A current account is meant for frequent business transactions; it generally pays no interest and allows unlimited withdrawals.
explanation_ne: चालु खाता बारम्बार व्यापारिक कारोबारका लागि हो; यसमा सामान्यतया ब्याज दिइँदैन र असीमित निकासी गर्न सकिन्छ।

question: What is a bill of exchange?
question_ne: विनिमय बिल (बिल अफ एक्सचेन्ज) भनेको के हो?
options: A written order by one person to another to pay a specified sum on a fixed date
options_ne: निश्चित मितिमा तोकिएको रकम भुक्तानी गर्न एक व्यक्तिले अर्कोलाई दिएको लिखित आदेश
explanation: A bill of exchange is an unconditional written order by the drawer to the drawee to pay a specified sum on a fixed date.
explanation_ne: विनिमय बिल भनेको तोकिएको मितिमा तोकिएको रकम भुक्तानी गर्न लेखकले प्राप्तकर्तालाई दिएको शर्तरहित लिखित आदेश हो।

question: What is a promissory note?
question_ne: प्रतिज्ञापत्र (प्रोमिसरी नोट) भनेको के हो?
options: A written promise by a person to pay a specified sum on demand or on a fixed date
A note promising to buy shares
A bank's promise to pay interest
options_ne: माग्नासाथ वा तोकिएको मितिमा तोकिएको रकम भुक्तानी गर्ने व्यक्तिको लिखित प्रतिज्ञा
explanation: A promissory note is a written promise by the maker to pay a specified sum to a person on demand or on a fixed date.
explanation_ne: प्रतिज्ञापत्र भनेको माग्नासाथ वा तोकिएको मितिमा तोकिएको रकम भुक्तानी गर्ने व्यक्तिको लिखित प्रतिज्ञा हो।

question: What is the primary market in the capital market?
question_ne: पुँजी बजारमा प्राथमिक बजार भनेको के हो?
options: The market where new securities are issued and sold for the first time
The market where old securities are traded
The market for government bonds only
options_ne: नयाँ धितोपत्र पहिलो पटक जारी गरी बिक्री हुने बजार
explanation: The primary market is where new securities are issued and sold to investors for the first time (e.g., through an IPO).
explanation_ne: प्राथमिक बजारमा नयाँ धितोपत्र पहिलो पटक लगानीकर्तालाई जारी गरी बिक्री गरिन्छ (जस्तै, आईपीओमार्फत)।

question: What is the secondary market in the capital market?
question_ne: पुँजी बजारमा द्वितीयक बजार भनेको के हो?
options: The market where already-issued securities are bought and sold among investors
The market where new shares are issued
The market for primary dealers only
options_ne: पहिले नै जारी भइसकेका धितोपत्र लगानीकर्ताहरूबीच किनबेच हुने बजार
explanation: The secondary market — such as the Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) — is where already-issued securities are traded among investors.
explanation_ne: द्वितीयक बजार — जस्तै नेपाल स्टक एक्सचेन्ज (नेप्से) — मा पहिले नै जारी भइसकेका धितोपत्र लगानीकर्ताहरूबीच कारोबार हुन्छ।

question: What is a mortgage?
question_ne: धितो (मोर्टगेज) भनेको के हो?
options: A loan secured by immovable property such as land or a house
A loan given to the government
options_ne: जग्गा वा घरजस्तो अचल सम्पत्ति धितो राखेर दिइने ऋण
explanation: A mortgage is a loan secured by immovable property (land, house or building); the lender can sell the property if the borrower defaults.
explanation_ne: धितो भनेको जग्गा वा घरजस्तो अचल सम्पत्ति धितो राखेर दिइने ऋण हो; ऋणीले भुक्तानी नगरेमा ऋणदाताले सम्पत्ति बिक्री गर्न सक्छ।

question: What is hypothecation in banking?
question_ne: बैंकिङमा हाइपोथिकेसन भनेको के हो?
options: A charge on movable property where the borrower keeps possession of the asset
A charge on land where the bank takes possession
A guarantee by a third party
options_ne: चल सम्पत्तिमा लगाइने भार, जसमा ऋणीले सम्पत्ति आफैँसँग राख्छ
जग्गामा लगाइने भार, जसमा बैंकले कब्जा लिन्छ
explanation: Hypothecation is a charge on movable property (e.g., a vehicle or stock) where the borrower retains possession while the lender has a claim on it.
explanation_ne: हाइपोथिकेसन चल सम्पत्ति (जस्तै, सवारीसाधन वा स्टक) मा लगाइने भार हो, जसमा ऋणीले सम्पत्ति आफैँसँग राख्छ तर ऋणदाताको त्यसमा दाबी रहन्छ।

question: What is a pledge in banking?
question_ne: बैंकिङमा धरौटी (प्लेज) भनेको के हो?
options: A bailment of movable goods to a lender as security, with possession transferred
A promise to repay a loan
options_ne: धितोका रूपमा चल सम्पत्ति ऋणदातालाई सुम्पिनु, कब्जा हस्तान्तरणसहित
explanation: A pledge is the bailment of movable goods (e.g., gold or goods) to a lender as security, with possession transferred to the lender.
explanation_ne: धरौटी भनेको धितोका रूपमा चल सम्पत्ति (जस्तै, सुन वा सामान) ऋणदातालाई कब्जासहित सुम्पिनु हो।

question: What is a lien in banking?
question_ne: बैंकिङमा लियन भनेको के हो?
options: A bank's legal right to retain a customer's property until a debt is paid
A right to open an account
options_ne: ऋण नतिरेसम्म ग्राहकको सम्पत्ति राख्ने बैंकको कानुनी अधिकार
explanation: A lien is a bank's legal right to retain a customer's property or securities until the customer's debt is paid.
explanation_ne: लियन भनेको ग्राहकको ऋण नतिरेसम्म उसको सम्पत्ति वा धितोपत्र राख्ने बैंकको कानुनी अधिकार हो।

question: Who is a guarantor in a loan agreement?
question_ne: ऋण सम्झौतामा ग्यारेन्टर (जमानतकर्ता) भनेको को हो?
options: A person who promises to repay the loan if the borrower fails to do so
The bank officer who approves the loan
The person who receives the loan
The lawyer who drafts the agreement
options_ne: ऋणीले ऋण नतिरेमा तिर्ने प्रतिज्ञा गर्ने व्यक्ति
explanation: A guarantor is a person who undertakes to repay a loan if the borrower defaults.
explanation_ne: ग्यारेन्टर भनेको ऋणीले ऋण नतिरेमा तिर्ने जिम्मेवारी लिने व्यक्ति हो।

question: What is a working capital loan?
question_ne: कार्यशील पुँजी ऋण भनेको के हो?
options: A short-term loan to finance a business's day-to-day operations
A long-term loan to buy land
A loan to build a factory
options_ne: व्यवसायको दैनिक सञ्चालनका लागि दिइने अल्पकालीन ऋण
explanation: A working capital loan is a short-term loan to finance a business's day-to-day operations, such as buying raw materials and paying wages.
explanation_ne: कार्यशील पुँजी ऋण भनेको कच्चा पदार्थ किन्ने र ज्याला तिर्नेजस्ता व्यवसायको दैनिक सञ्चालनका लागि दिइने अल्पकालीन ऋण हो।

question: What is the bank rate of a central bank?
question_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकको बैंक दर भनेको के हो?
options: The rate at which the central bank lends to commercial banks
The rate banks charge their customers
options_ne: केन्द्रीय बैंकले वाणिज्य बैंकहरूलाई ऋण दिने दर
explanation: The bank rate is the rate at which the central bank lends money to commercial banks; in Nepal it is the upper bound of NRB's interest rate corridor (6% in FY 2082/83).
explanation_ne: बैंक दर भनेको केन्द्रीय बैंकले वाणिज्य बैंकहरूलाई ऋण दिने दर हो; नेपालमा यो नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंकको ब्याजदर करिडोरको माथिल्लो सीमा हो (आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३ मा ६%)।

question: Under Basel III, what is Tier 2 capital of a bank?
question_ne: बासेल तेस्रोअन्तर्गत बैंकको टियर २ पुँजी भनेको के हो?
options: Supplementary capital such as subordinated debt and revaluation reserves
options_ne: अधीनस्थ ऋण र पुनर्मूल्याङ्कन कोषजस्तो पूरक पुँजी
explanation: Tier 2 capital is supplementary capital, including subordinated debt, revaluation reserves and general provisions, that supports Tier 1 capital.
explanation_ne: टियर २ पुँजी पूरक पुँजी हो, जसमा अधीनस्थ ऋण, पुनर्मूल्याङ्कन कोष र सामान्य व्यवस्थाहरू पर्छन् र यसले टियर १ पुँजीलाई सघाउँछ।

question: What is the leverage ratio of a bank?
question_ne: बैंकको लिभरेज अनुपात भनेको के हो?
options: Tier 1 capital divided by total exposure (assets), a non-risk-based capital measure
Total loans divided by total deposits
options_ne: टियर १ पुँजी भाग कुल एक्सपोजर (सम्पत्ति), जोखिममा आधारित नभएको पुँजी मापदण्ड
explanation: The leverage ratio is Tier 1 capital divided by total exposure; unlike the capital adequacy ratio it does not weight assets by risk.
explanation_ne: लिभरेज अनुपात टियर १ पुँजी भाग कुल एक्सपोजर हो; पुँजी पर्याप्तता अनुपातभन्दा फरक, यसले सम्पत्तिलाई जोखिमअनुसार भार दिँदैन।

question: What is provisioning for bad loans in banking?
question_ne: बैंकिङमा खराब ऋणका लागि व्यवस्था (प्रोभिजनिङ) भनेको के हो?
options: Setting aside funds from profit to cover expected losses on loans
Writing off all bad loans at once
Reducing the interest rate on bad loans
options_ne: ऋणमा अपेक्षित नोक्सानी पूरा गर्न नाफाबाट रकम छुट्याउनु
सबै खराब ऋण एकै पटक मिनाहा गर्नु
ऋण नतिर्ने ऋणीलाई थप ऋण दिनु
explanation: Provisioning means setting aside funds from profits to cover expected losses on non-performing loans.
explanation_ne: प्रोभिजनिङ भनेको खराब ऋणमा अपेक्षित नोक्सानी पूरा गर्न नाफाबाट रकम छुट्याउनु हो।

question: What is a loan write-off in banking?
question_ne: बैंकिङमा ऋण मिनाहा (राइट-अफ) भनेको के हो?
options: Removing an unrecoverable loan from the balance sheet as a loss
Forgiving a loan without any record
Reducing the loan amount by half
Transferring a loan to another bank
options_ne: असुल हुन नसक्ने ऋणलाई नोक्सानीका रूपमा वासलातबाट हटाउनु
explanation: A write-off removes an unrecoverable loan from the bank's balance sheet, recognising it as a loss; the bank may still pursue recovery.
explanation_ne: राइट-अफले असुल हुन नसक्ने ऋणलाई नोक्सानीका रूपमा बैंकको वासलातबाट हटाउँछ; बैंकले असुलीको प्रयास भने जारी राख्न सक्छ।

question: What is the Credit Information Bureau in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालको कर्जा सूचना केन्द्र भनेको के हो?
options: An institution that collects and shares borrowers' credit history with banks
A bureau that gives loans to the public
A government office that prints currency
A bureau that regulates the stock market
options_ne: ऋणीहरूको कर्जा इतिहास सङ्कलन गरी बैंकहरूसँग साझा गर्ने संस्था
explanation: The Credit Information Bureau collects borrowers' credit histories and shares them with banks and financial institutions to support lending decisions.
explanation_ne: कर्जा सूचना केन्द्रले ऋणीहरूको कर्जा इतिहास सङ्कलन गरी ऋण निर्णयमा सघाउन बैंक तथा वित्तीय संस्थाहरूसँग साझा गर्छ।

question: What does it mean for a borrower to be blacklisted by a bank in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा बैंकले ऋणीलाई कालोसूचीमा राख्नु भनेको के हो?
options: The borrower is listed as a wilful defaulter and cannot get new loans from any bank
The borrower is given a new loan at a lower rate
The borrower's account is closed permanently
The borrower is fined by the court
options_ne: ऋणीलाई जानीबुझी ऋण नतिर्ने व्यक्तिका रूपमा सूचीकृत गरिन्छ र कुनै पनि बैंकबाट नयाँ ऋण पाउँदैन
ऋणीलाई कम दरमा नयाँ ऋण दिइन्छ
ऋणीको खाता स्थायी रूपमा बन्द गरिन्छ
explanation: A blacklisted borrower is listed as a wilful defaulter by the Credit Information Bureau and cannot obtain new loans from any bank or financial institution in Nepal.
explanation_ne: कालोसूचीमा परेको ऋणीलाई कर्जा सूचना केन्द्रले जानीबुझी ऋण नतिर्ने व्यक्तिका रूपमा सूचीकृत गर्छ र उसले नेपालको कुनै पनि बैंक वा वित्तीय संस्थाबाट नयाँ ऋण पाउँदैन।

question: What is the New Development Bank (NDB)?
question_ne: नयाँ विकास बैंक (एनडीबी) भनेको के हो?
options: A multilateral bank founded by the BRICS countries in 2014, headquartered in Shanghai
A bank founded by the World Bank in 1944
A bank of the European Union
A bank founded by Nepal in 2014
options_ne: सन् २०१४ मा ब्रिक्स देशहरूले स्थापना गरेको बहुपक्षीय बैंक, मुख्यालय सांघाई
सन् १९४४ मा विश्व बैंकले स्थापना गरेको बैंक
सन् २०१४ मा नेपालले स्थापना गरेको बैंक
explanation: The New Development Bank was founded by the BRICS countries in 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
explanation_ne: नयाँ विकास बैंक सन् २०१४ मा ब्रिक्स देशहरूले स्थापना गरेको बहुपक्षीय बैंक हो र यसको मुख्यालय चीनको सांघाईमा छ।

question: What is the International Finance Corporation (IFC)?
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय वित्त निगम (आईएफसी) भनेको के हो?
options: The World Bank Group arm that supports private sector development
The IMF's lending arm for governments
The Asian Development Bank's private arm
options_ne: निजी क्षेत्रको विकासमा सघाउने विश्व बैंक समूहको निकाय
explanation: The International Finance Corporation is the World Bank Group institution that supports private sector development in developing countries.
explanation_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय वित्त निगम विकासोन्मुख देशहरूमा निजी क्षेत्रको विकासमा सघाउने विश्व बैंक समूहको संस्था हो।

question: What is the Bank for International Settlements (BIS)?
question_ne: अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय निपटान बैंक (बीआईएस) भनेको के हो?
options: An international organisation of central banks, based in Basel, Switzerland
options_ne: स्विट्जरल्यान्डको बासेलमा रहेको केन्द्रीय बैंकहरूको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संस्था
explanation: The Bank for International Settlements, based in Basel, Switzerland, is an international organisation that serves central banks and fosters monetary and financial cooperation.
explanation_ne: स्विट्जरल्यान्डको बासेलमा रहेको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय निपटान बैंक केन्द्रीय बैंकहरूलाई सेवा दिने र मौद्रिक तथा वित्तीय सहयोग बढाउने अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय संस्था हो।

question: What is the Nepal Clearing House?
question_ne: नेपाल क्लियरिङ हाउस भनेको के हो?
options: An institution that clears interbank cheques and electronic payments in Nepal
A house where Nepali currency is printed
A government office for tax collection
A bank that clears foreign cheques only
options_ne: नेपालमा अन्तरबैंक चेक र विद्युतीय भुक्तानी समाशोधन गर्ने संस्था
विदेशी चेक मात्र समाशोधन गर्ने बैंक
explanation: Nepal Clearing House Ltd. operates the country's interbank cheque clearing and electronic payment systems, including connectIPS and NCHL-IPS.
explanation_ne: नेपाल क्लियरिङ हाउस लिमिटेडले देशको अन्तरबैंक चेक समाशोधन र कनेक्टआईपीएस तथा एनसीएचएल-आईपीएससहितका विद्युतीय भुक्तानी प्रणाली सञ्चालन गर्छ।

question: What is remittance in the context of Nepal's economy?
question_ne: नेपालको अर्थतन्त्रको सन्दर्भमा रेमिट्यान्स भनेको के हो?
options: Money sent home by Nepalis working abroad
Money sent by the government to provinces
options_ne: विदेशमा काम गर्ने नेपालीहरूले घर पठाएको पैसा
explanation: Remittance is money sent home by Nepalis working abroad; it is one of the largest sources of foreign exchange for Nepal, with about 1,500 people leaving daily for foreign work.
explanation_ne: रेमिट्यान्स भनेको विदेशमा काम गर्ने नेपालीहरूले घर पठाएको पैसा हो; यो नेपालका लागि विदेशी मुद्राको सबैभन्दा ठूलो स्रोतमध्ये एक हो।
